raw_problem.problem_text:
证明在伽利略变换下薛定谔方程具有不变性，即设惯系 $\textrm { K } ^ { \prime }$ ＇以速度 v相对于惯性系 K（沿$\mathbf { X }$ 轴正方向）运动时，空间任何一点，两座标系中的坐标满足：

$$
\left\{ \begin{array}{l} x = x ^ {\prime} + v t ^ {\prime} \\ t ^ {\prime} = t \end{array} \quad y = y ^ {\prime} \quad z = z ^ {\prime} \right. \tag {1}
$$

势能在 $\mathrm { ~ K ~ } ^ { \prime } \mathrm { ~ K ~ }$ 两坐标系中的表示式有下列关系

$$
\mathrm {V} ^ {\prime} \left(\mathrm {x} ^ {\prime}, \mathrm {t} ^ {\prime}\right) = \mathrm {V} ^ {\prime} (\mathrm {x} - \mathrm {v t}, \mathrm {t}) = \mathrm {V} (\mathrm {x}, \mathrm {t}) \tag {2}
$$
raw_problem.solution_text:
证明若在 $\textrm { K } ^ { \prime }$ ＇中薛定谔方程式是

![](images/104140adee79de3e294f2518dfe632eb029a95d98ab3562bc688bab92f9adb7e.jpg)

$$
\hbar i \frac {\partial \psi^ {\prime}}{\partial t ^ {\prime}} = \left(- \frac {\hbar^ {2}}{2 \mu} \frac {\partial^ {2}}{\partial x ^ {\prime 2}} + V ^ {\prime}\right) \psi^ {\prime}
$$

则在 $\textrm { K } ^ { \prime }$ ＇中： $\hbar i \frac { \partial \psi } { \partial t } = ( - \frac { \hbar ^ { 2 } } { 2 \mu } \frac { \partial ^ { 2 } } { \partial x ^ { 2 } } + V ) \psi$ x 

其中： $\psi ( x , t ) = e ^ { i ( \frac { \nu } { \hbar } x - \frac { \nu ^ { 2 } } { 2 \hbar } t ) } \times \psi ^ { \prime } ( x - \nu t , t )$ (3)

[证明]从伽利略变换定义可知，在⑴式中当 $\scriptstyle \mathbf { t } = 0$ 时， $\mathbf { \Delta x } { = } \mathbf { X } ^ { ' }$ ＇， $\mathrm { \Delta t { = } t ^ { \prime } }$ ＇，因此在时刻 $\scriptstyle \mathbf { t = } 0$ 一点的波函数 $\psi ( x , t )$ 与 $\psi ^ { \prime } ( x ^ { \prime } , t ^ { \prime } )$ 相重合，这个关系和 $\ S 5 . 1$ ⑵的海森伯，薛定谔表象变换:

$$
\varphi (\vec {r}, t) = e ^ {- i \hat {H} t / \hbar} \psi (\vec {r}, 0)
$$

为普遍起见,我们假设 $\mathrm { \bf K } , { \bf K } ^ { \prime }$ 间的变换用一未知的么正算符 $\hat { U } ( \boldsymbol { x } , t )$ 表示。关于这一点也可以用变换前后的几率相等来解释 $\left| \psi ( x , t ) \right| ^ { 2 } = \left| \psi ( x ^ { \prime } , t ^ { \prime } ) \right| ^ { 2 }$

$$
\psi^ {\prime} \left(x ^ {\prime}, t ^ {\prime}\right) = \hat {U} (x, t) \psi (x, t) \tag {4}
$$

逆变换 $\psi ( x , t ) = \hat { U } ^ { - 1 } ( x , t ) \psi ^ { \prime } ( x ^ { \prime } , t ^ { \prime } )$ ⑸

从⑴知道： $\frac { \partial } { \partial x ^ { \prime } } = \frac { \partial x } { \partial x ^ { \prime } } \bullet \frac { \partial } { \partial x } = \frac { \partial } { \partial x }$ $\frac { \partial } { \partial t ^ { \prime } } = \frac { \partial t } { \partial t ^ { \prime } } \frac { \partial } { \partial t } + \frac { \partial x } { \partial t ^ { \prime } } \frac { \partial } { \partial x } = \frac { \partial } { \partial t } + \nu \frac { \partial } { \partial x }$ ⑹

已知在 $\textrm { K } ^ { \prime }$ ＇描写态的波函数 $\psi ^ { \prime } ( x ^ { \prime } , t ^ { \prime } )$ 满足：

$$
\hbar i \frac {\partial \psi^ {\prime}}{\partial t ^ {\prime}} = - \frac {\hbar}{2 \mu} \frac {\partial^ {2}}{\partial x ^ {\prime 2}} \psi^ {\prime} \left(x ^ {\prime}, t ^ {\prime}\right) + V \left(x ^ {\prime}, t ^ {\prime}\right) \psi^ {\prime} \left(x ^ {\prime}, t ^ {\prime}\right) \tag {7}
$$

将⑷和⑹的关系代入；并注意势能 V（x,t）是变换的不变量

$$
\hbar i \left(\frac {\partial}{\partial t} + v \frac {\partial}{\partial x}\right) \hat {U} \psi (x, t) = - \frac {\hbar^ {2}}{2 \mu} \frac {\partial^ {2}}{\partial x ^ {2}} \hat {U} \psi (x, t) + \hat {V} (x, t) \hat {U} \psi (x, t)
$$

展开得： $\hbar i ( \frac { \partial \hat { U } } { \partial t } \psi + \hat { U } \frac { \partial \psi } { \partial t } + \nu \frac { \partial \hat { U } } { \partial x } \psi + \nu \hat { U } \frac { \partial \psi } { \partial x } )$ ˆ  UU  ˆ  vUU 

$$
= - \frac {\hbar}{2 \mu} \left(\hat {U} \frac {\partial^ {2} \psi}{\partial x ^ {2}} + 2 \frac {\partial \hat {U}}{\partial x} \cdot \frac {\partial \psi}{\partial x} + \frac {\partial^ {2} U}{\partial x ^ {2}} \psi\right) + \hat {V} \cdot \hat {U} \cdot \psi \tag {8}
$$

式子⑻中的变换算符没有单一解，但是，假定象题中指定的，要求另一座标系 K 中，薛定谔方程式有完全相同的形式，即下式成立的话：

$$
\hbar i \frac {\partial \psi}{\partial t} = - \frac {\hbar^ {2}}{2 \mu} \frac {\partial^ {2}}{\partial x ^ {2}} \psi (x, t) + V (x, t) \psi (x, t) \tag {9}
$$

那末⑻式中 $\hat { U }$ 需要受到限制，即⑻必需化简为⑼，为此比较⑻式左右方 $\psi , \frac { \hat { \sigma } \psi } { \hat { \sigma } x }$  的系数，容易看出，下面二式满足时⑻化为⑼的形式：

$$
\left\{ \begin{array}{l} \hbar i \left(\frac {\partial \hat {U}}{\partial t} + v \frac {\partial \hat {U}}{\partial x}\right) = - \frac {\hbar^ {2}}{2 \mu} \frac {\partial^ {2} \hat {U}}{\partial x ^ {2}} \\ \hbar i v \hat {U} = \frac {\hbar^ {2}}{\mu} \frac {\partial U}{\partial x} \end{array} \right. \tag {10}
$$

将（11）积分，得到：

$$
\hat {U} (x, t) = \hat {c} (t) e ^ {- \frac {\mu v i}{\hbar} x} \tag {12}
$$

$\hat { c } ( t )$ 是个与 t 有关的算符，再将（12）代入（10），得到： $\frac { \partial \hat { c } ( t ) } { \partial t } = \frac { \mu \nu ^ { 2 } i } { 2 \hbar } \hat { c } ( t )$
